title: Very Nice Plants
text: The plant arrived quickly and they were all in one piece. They were very beautiful and very healthy. My only complaint is the price. Don't get me wrong, I understand that plants as beautifully grown as these can be costly, but i am seeing other subscriptions quite a bit cheaper. I'm trying different subscriptions out right now. Who know's Costa Farms might be the best one in the end. We shall see :) Very satisfied with my Costa Farms plants
label: positive
